question: Ruksana travelled at 60 km/h while going from point A to point B and returned via the same route at a different speed. If Ruksana’s overall average speed during the two-way journey was 48 km/h, what was her speed while travelling from B to A?
solution:
Given:

The speed of the car is travelling is 60 km/hr and Average Speed is 48 km/hr

Formula used:

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

Time = Distance/Speed

Calculation:

Let the Speed for returning be S.

Let the distance between A and B be x

2x/48 = x/60 + x/S

⇒ 2x/48 - x/60 = x/S

⇒ x/24 - x/60 = x/S

⇒3x/120 = x/S

⇒S = 40 km/h

Required speed = S = 40 km/hr

∴ The Required speed for returning is 40 km/hr.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Calculation:

⇒ (2 × S₁ × S₂)/(S₁ + S₂) = Average speed

⇒ (2 × 60 × S2)/(60 + S2) = 48

⇒ 5 × S₂ = 120 + 2 × S₂

⇒ 3 × S2 = 120

⇒ S2 = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40 km/h.**
